name: Sudan
value: Drone strikes on grid and civilians
summary: Drone strikes on Sudan's grid and civilians continue; UN warns of their deadly impact
state: The UN warned in early November of the impact of deadly drone strikes in Sudan, which have hit power plants and civilians (UN News). A drone strike on a fuel station in South Kordofan on 4 Nov killed at least seven people (Sudan Tribune). The IPC has warned of a growing famine risk in Darfur and Kordofan, and no peace talks are under way.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice: it advises against all travel to Sudan.
rubric_hit: Repeated mass-casualty strikes and famine risk = Alert
